key_insight: Medi-Gemma combines deterministic EMR analytics with retrieval-augmented generation to make clinical decision support more traceable and less prone to hallucination.
clinical_relevance: The system is designed to improve wound triage and workflow automation by grounding responses in validated patient data and fixed safety pathways.
method: ClinicalOrchestrator coordinates the pipeline across data handling, routing, retrieval, and safety checks.
DataManager cleans EMR inputs and IntentRouter sends queries either to Pandas-based deterministic analytics or to a ClinicalRAGEngine for patient-specific reasoning.
Ground Truth Injection and SafetyVerifier add validated clinical state to prompts and filter outputs against rule violations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that validation reduced semantic context drift, avoided database compilation crashes, and improved factual adherence to backend clinical repositories.
watch_item: The architecture depends on reliable structured data extraction, routing, and rule mapping, so real-world performance may vary with messy EMR inputs and implementation complexity.
paper_title: Medi-Gemma: A Hybrid Clinical Decision Support System Integrating Deterministic EMR Analytics and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
